releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.7 (Build 84):
• Progressive Liquid Glass Blur Shield: Replaced flat black gradients with GPU-accelerated frosted glass blur (24px, 190% saturation boost) and smooth 8-stop S-curve alpha masks.
• Precision 1:1 Matching Send Pod: Sized circular send button to 50px, matching the typing capsule height, with optical centering and rich active illumination.
• Dedicated Full-Width Quotation Bar: Replaced Home streak pill with a dedicated inspirational quote marquee featuring an amber duotone Quotes badge.
• Seamless Startup & Navigation Transitions: Eliminated startup freezing by debouncing native notification scheduling and wrapping tab transitions in React startTransition.
• Rock-Solid Container Cards: Fixed outer bento and hero containers across Home, Gym, and Nutrition, maintaining micro-interactions exclusively inside components.
• Full Application Refresh Handler: Upgraded header reload button to sync cloud state and cleanly refresh application memory.
• Universal Medium Haptics: Unified tactile feedback across core navigation and interactive surfaces.
• Navigation Droplet Hold & Drag: 120Hz pointer tracking with haptic boundary crossing and elastic snapping.
